retrieval_metrics.unanswerable_evaluation_note: Unanswerable questions are excluded from retrieval relevance metrics. recall@k is the mean fraction of all labelled passages found; question_recall@k is the fraction of questions with at least one labelled passage found. This report does not measure abstention or answer quality.

answerability.calibration_method: Set the partial threshold just above the highest development-set unanswerable score, then set the answer threshold at least as high as the development answerable-score median.

limitations: Thresholds are supplied configuration, not calibrated probabilities.
Partial decisions count as accepted for coverage and risk.
Questions with missing scores are always abstained on.
Metrics are only as reliable as the answerability labels supplied.
AURC uses the trapezoidal rule over observed unique score thresholds.
